details: All five criteria pass: the dirty-flag + RAF pattern in `render()` correctly coalesces rapid `pointermove`/drag events; no cross-view dispatch creates feedback loops; scales are static so no stale-closure risk; there are zero `.transition()` calls so no mid-flight race; and the Pointer Events API (`pointerdown/move/up` + `setPointerCapture`) unifies mouse and touch without double-firing. Minor concern: `updateScatters` performs full D3 data-joins on up to 6000 DOM nodes per RAF frame (2000 pts × 3 panels), which could still cause jank under heavy interaction despite the RAF gate.
